title: Nothing criminal found in Surrey death
subtitle: Vancouver police find no criminal actions by RCMP in man's in-custody Surrey street death
article: Vancouver police have concluded there are "no reasonable grounds" to believe RCMP committed a criminal offence in the in-custody death of a Surrey, B.C. man in 2010.
Victor Bikermanjit Singh Kooner died on June 22 last year after police were called on a report of a man running in and out of traffic near 88th Avenue and 160th Street just before 11 p.m. PT
Officers found the man acting erratically and apprehended him, while also calling an ambulance.
Vancouver police say Kooner went into medical distress before help came.
"He died despite the efforts of officers and paramedics," a statement from the Vancouver Police Department said.
Vancouver Police detectives conducted a lengthy investigation and have decided the file won't be forwarded to the Crown.
A coroner's inquest has been scheduled.
